name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fixes friends' titles that need converting failing with HTTP 502 ("fatal error" in the browser) when the friend has not set its own public address in the Federation settings: the friend answered every converted play with 502 and logged nothing. Both servers should update. Plex users: install Jellyfin.Plugin.Federation.Plex-0.0.210.zip from this release. Includes everything in 0.0.209.
